\chapter{Additional Design Diagrams}\label{app:diagrams}
This appendix indexes every design diagram in the report. It is also the place for full-page
versions of diagrams too dense to read at text size; at present none is needed, because every
diagram prints readably where it appears. Every diagram drawn for this report except the schedule
is written in PlantUML, kept in \path{mid-eval-report/diagrams/m<N>/} beside its rendered image in
\path{figures/m<N>/}; the schedule is drawn by a Python script, \path{mid-eval-report/scripts/gantt.py}.
Either way, each diagram's source and history are in the repository like the code's.

\section*{Index of design diagrams}

what it was drawn from. Behaviour and data diagrams show only what is built on \texttt{main};
the architecture, use-case and schedule diagrams show the whole project, with planned parts marked.

is already rotated to a full page, and the domain model and the evidence data flow fill the text
width and most of the page height respectively, so none is repeated here.
